$comment: Model map for example 07: the pilot's fields and measures expressed in a model that tools/new_model.py built from the outdoor-shop data. The same map fits the CSV, Excel and ODBC versions of that model.

목표매출.expr: VAR lastDay = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Orders[Order Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ) RETURN IF ( ISFILTERED ( Products[Product] ) || ISFILTERED ( Products[Subcategory] ) || ISCROSSFILTERED ( Stores ), BLANK (), CALCULATE ( [Total Amount], TREATAS ( VALUES ( Products[Category] ), Budget[Category] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )

이익 증감률.expr: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [이익] ), DIVIDE ( [이익] - [전년 이익], [전년 이익] ) )

전년 대비 증감률.expr: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [매출] ), DIVIDE ( [매출] - [전년 매출], [전년 매출] ) )

전년 매출.expr: VAR lastDay = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Orders[Order Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [매출], CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( Calendar[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )

전년 이익.expr: VAR lastDay = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Orders[Order Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [이익], CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( Calendar[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )

Orders PY.expr: VAR lastDay = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Orders[Order Date] ), REMOVEFILTERS () ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [주문건수], CALCULATETABLE ( SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR ( Calendar[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( Calendar[Date] <= lastDay ) ) )
